messages:
marta (Security): Auditor asked for a concise verification flow for exported SOC2 evidence bundles: RBAC diffs, KMS usage logs, and incident artifacts. Need to confirm signing, redaction, and access window.
raj (Infra): Proposal: produce a bundle per sample, compute sha256 for each file, create a manifest, sign manifest with GPG (internal key) and KMS Sign, upload artifacts + manifest + signatures to evidence S3.
auditor_miller: auditors need exact verification steps and the public key fingerprints. Also presigned URLs for downloads (7d) and an index that maps controls -> bundle paths.
selene (SRE): operational notes: RBAC evidence = git diff (infra) + `kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json` snapshot; include commit hash and approver in S3 metadata. For incidents include `timeline.csv` + session logs.
oliver (Compliance): redaction rule: PII must be removed from copies. Keep originals in locked bucket `s3://redwood-compliance-originals/` and provide original checksums and a signed redaction report. Mark redacted fields in manifest.
raj (Infra): CLI snippets: `sha256sum artifact > artifact.sha256`; GPG sign: `gpg --detach-sign -o manifest.sig manifest.jsonl`; KMS sign: `aws kms sign --key-id alias/redwood-audit-sign --message-type DIGEST --message-blob fileb://manifest.sha256 --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256`.
auditor_miller: include verification example in the manifest header: how to verify GPG signature + how to verify KMS signature with exported CMK public key. Also include timestamp in RFC3339 and signer github handle.
marta (Security): I'll create a compact evidence-index CSV template: columns: ControlID, SampleID, BundleS3Path, PresignedURL, ManifestSHA256, GPGSigPath, KMSSigPath, RedactionFlag, Notes. We'll add a short "how-to-verify" text in the CSV header.
selene (SRE): add an IR quick-run step to playbook: capture RBAC, run saved Splunk search for KMS events, assemble bundle, compute checksums, sign manifest, upload, and send CSV row.
raj (Infra): I'll automate presigned URL generation (7d) and include it in the CSV. Also set S3 object metadata keys: x-amz-meta-commit, x-amz-meta-pr, x-amz-meta-approver, x-amz-meta-kms-key-arn.
oliver (Compliance): good. auditor_miller, once you pick samples we'll produce bundles and share the CSV. Any further requirements?
auditor_miller: please ensure public GPG fingerprint is posted to the compliance site and provide one verification script. Happy to review samples after upload.
marta (Security): action items: raj automate signing+presign, selene add playbook step, i'll draft CSV + verification text and publish GPG fingerprint. Target: exports available EOD tomorrow.
